description.zh:
流程定义，遵循Flow Definition Language (FDL)语法标准。考虑到向前兼容，当系统支持两种规范的流程定义规范。
> 
> 以上流程定义示例中Name：my_flow_name是指流程名称，需和入参Name保持一致
description.en:
The definition of the flow. The definition must follow the syntax of Flow Definition Language (FDL). For forward compatibility, the system supports two versions of the flow definition specification.

> In the preceding example, Name: my\_flow\_name indicates the flow name, which must be the same as the value of the Name request parameter.

description.zh: 配置 Flow 执行期间可以访问的变量列表
description.en: The list of variables that can be accessed during the execution of the flow.
The name of the flow that you created.

description.zh: 流程执行依赖的授权角色资源描述符信息。用于在执行流程时，流程执行引擎扮演该角色（AssumeRole）调用相关的流程资源API。
description.en: The resource descriptor of the role that the flow execution relies on. When a flow is executed, the execution engine assumes this role to call the related resource APIs.
The type of the flow. Set the value to **FDL**.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun fnf update-flow --name my_flow_name --definition 'Legacy_version:_type:_flow_version:_v1_name:_my_flow_name_steps:_ -_type:_pass_ name:_mypass_New_version:_Type:_StateMachine_SpecVersion:_v1_Name:_my_flow_name_StartAt:_my_state_States:_ -_Type:_Pass_ Name:_my_state_ End:_true' --description my_test_flow --type FDL --role-arn acs:ram:_region_:_accountID_:_role --environment '{"Variables":[{"Description":"description","Value":"value","Name":"key"}]}' --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun fnf UpdateFlow --region cn-hangzhou --Type FDL --Description my_test_flow --Definition 'Legacy_version:_type:_flow_version:_v1_name:_my_flow_name_steps:_ -_type:_pass_ name:_mypass_New_version:_Type:_StateMachine_SpecVersion:_v1_Name:_my_flow_name_StartAt:_my_state_States:_ -_Type:_Pass_ Name:_my_state_ End:_true' --Environment '{"Variables":[{"Description":"description","Value":"value","Name":"key"}]}' --RoleArn 'acs:ram:_region_:_accountID_:_role' --Name my_flow_name
